audit_items.proof_trace: Interest is accrued on the debt before the refund is computed (obligation.move:L149 calls accrue_interest, updating debt.amount to the current borrow index). unsafe_repay_debt_only computes residule = MAX(0, amount - ceil(debt)), and coin.split(residule, ctx) atomically creates the refund coin. The repay entry point either destroys zero refunds or transfers them to ctx.sender(); coin::destroy_zero aborts on any non-zero amount, guaranteeing no silent suppression.
